div.p: Everything you need to know about ordering from ABJ AIBAOJI.

div.div: Phnom Penh and Ta Khmau: same or next day. Provinces: 2–4 working days via VET or J&T Express. You'll receive a tracking message as soon as your parcel ships.
Flat $1.50 in Phnom Penh, $2.50 to provinces — and free on all orders over $35.
Yes — cash on delivery is available nationwide, or pay online securely by ABA PayWay and bank transfer at checkout.
Unopened products can be returned within 14 days for a full refund. If a product arrives damaged, send us a photo within 48 hours and we'll replace it free of charge.

h3.button: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?

div.div: Our formulas are mild and non-irritating, designed to protect the skin barrier. As with any skincare, patch-test on your inner arm for 24 hours before first use.
Always. We never test on animals.

h3.button: What order should I apply my routine in?

div.div: Thinnest to thickest: Facial Foam → Serum → Night Cream (evenings) → Sunscreen (mornings). Add the Face Mask 2–3 times a week.

h3.button: Can I use the serum and the face masks together?

div.div: Yes — they're designed to work together. Use the Serum daily and the Face Mask 2–3 evenings a week, applying the serum after you remove the mask.
